findings.headline: Most severe narrative “Posts list cyberattacks and outages including Bank of America account lockouts” (high severity): 53 posts (Telegram 26, X 13, YouTube 9, LinkedIn 5); most on 19 Nov (26 posts), but Telegram did not cover every day (peak on fully covered sources: 17 Nov, 10 posts).
findings.detail: Rated high by the labeller: Coordinated near-identical alarm posts about account lockouts and attacks could cause panic. Telegram did not cover every day, so 19 Nov counts are not comparable across days. Claims: 2 supported, 1 unverified. First observed in collected data: 13 Nov.

findings.headline: Also high severity: narrative “Mass-posted Bank of America job listings across LinkedIn”: 31 posts (LinkedIn 29, Telegram 2); 12 of them on 20 Nov (partial day, 9 h in the window).
findings.detail: Rated high by the labeller: Coordinated identical job ads from many accounts; possible lure using the bank's name. Telegram did not cover every day, so 20 Nov counts are not comparable across days. On the fully covered sources (LinkedIn, X, YouTube) it peaked on 20 Nov (11 posts).

findings.headline: Strongest coordinated group C1: 267 Telegram accounts with 3 signal types (near-identical text, near-simultaneous posting, accounts created close together) over 267 supporting posts; 267 of those posts are in narrative “Telegram ads offering USDT conversion and cross-border fiat exchange”.
findings.detail: 267 Telegram accounts posted near-identical text, a median 20 s apart; all 267 were created within 3 days of each other. Group C4 (7 more accounts) also post mainly into “Telegram ads offering USDT conversion and cross-border fiat exchange”. 5 groups have 5+ accounts. Coordination is not proof of inauthentic behaviour; check the benign explanations.

findings.headline: 30 claims checked: 5 supported, 0 contradicted, 2 disputed, 23 unverified.
findings.detail: Most notable: “Iran is behind the cyber-attacks and banking issues affecting Bank of America.” is disputed (confidence 0.40). Reports confirm outages at major US banks including Bank of America, but DHS suggested AI could be responsible, while Iran is only linked to general cyberattacks on US infrastructure, not these bank outages.

findings.headline: Not every source covered the whole window: Telegram 4 of 8 days (posts on 4 of 8 UTC days (none on 13 Nov (partial), 14 Nov, 15 Nov, 17 Nov)).
findings.detail: Full coverage: X, YouTube, LinkedIn. Days a source did not reach are not evidence of silence.
